patterns.description: Customers frequently report dissatisfaction with the quality of food, indicating inconsistency or general poor preparation.
A notable number of customers perceive the prices to be too high for the value received.
Several reviews highlight issues with staff attitude, suggesting unfriendliness or poor service interactions.
Multiple customers found the restaurant's atmosphere or physical environment to be unsatisfactory.
A few reviews specifically mention negative experiences related to the cleanliness of the establishment.
Customers reported various other negative experiences not fitting into specific categories, indicating general dissatisfaction or specific minor issues.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently report dissatisfaction with the quality of food, indicating inconsistency or general poor preparation.
root_causes.cause: Inconsistent food preparation, use of low-quality ingredients, or issues with recipe adherence.

root_causes.pattern: A notable number of customers perceive the prices to be too high for the value received.
root_causes.cause: Perceived poor value for money, pricing not aligned with food quality or overall dining experience.

root_causes.pattern: Several reviews highlight issues with staff attitude, suggesting unfriendliness or poor service interactions.
root_causes.cause: Lack of staff training in customer service, low staff morale, or insufficient staffing leading to stress and poor interactions.

root_causes.pattern: Multiple customers found the restaurant's atmosphere or physical environment to be unsatisfactory.
root_causes.cause: Outdated decor, poor maintenance, overcrowding, or issues with noise levels/comfort.

root_causes.pattern: A few reviews specifically mention negative experiences related to the cleanliness of the establishment.
root_causes.cause: Inadequate cleaning protocols, insufficient staff for cleaning, or lack of attention to detail in hygiene.

root_causes.pattern: Customers reported various other negative experiences not fitting into specific categories, indicating general dissatisfaction or specific minor issues.
root_causes.cause: Broad category, could include specific operational failures, lack of amenities, or general dissatisfaction not captured by other categories.
